dialogues.jp: ぶぶぶ……。
dialogues.en: --*brrp brrp brrp*
dialogues.text: --*brrp brrp brrp*

dialogues.jp:
机の上の携帯電話が震えた。着信音はなく、バ
イブだ。
dialogues.en: The cell phone on my desk shook. It was on vibration mode.
dialogues.text: The cell phone on my desk shook. It was on vibration mode.

dialogues.jp: 「もしもし？」
dialogues.en: "Hello?"
dialogues.text: "Hello?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 『ああ、朝倉？　白河だけど……』
dialogues.en: "Ahh, Asakura? It's Shirakawa..."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, Asakura? It's Shirakawa..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ども。どうしたんです？」
dialogues.en: "Ah, hello. Can I help you?"
dialogues.text: "Ah, hello. Can I help you?"

dialogues.jp:
声の向こう側に、ざわざわと雑踏があるのが分
かる。
dialogues.en: I could hear a lot of hustle and bustle on her end.
dialogues.text: I could hear a lot of hustle and bustle on her end.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 『君、もしかして、ことりと一緒に居る？』
dialogues.en: "Is Kotori with you?"
dialogues.text: "Is Kotori with you?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「いや、居ませんけど……というか、今日は先
　生の結婚式ですよね？」
dialogues.en: "No, she's not... isn't today your wedding ceremony?"
dialogues.text: "No, she's not... isn't today your wedding ceremony?"

dialogues.jp:
確か、そのはず。なのに、“ことりと一緒に居
る？”とはどうしたわけだ？
dialogues.en:
It definitely was. So why did she ask whether Kotori was
with me?
dialogues.text:
It definitely was. So why did she ask whether Kotori was
with me?

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
『そうなんだけど……今朝から姿が見えないん
　だよ』
dialogues.en:
"You're right, but... I haven't seen Kotori at all this
morning."
dialogues.text:
"You're right, but... I haven't seen Kotori at all this
morning."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
『あの子、携帯持ってないだろ。連絡は付かな
　いし、式に遅刻するわけにはいかないし……』
dialogues.en:
"That girl doesn't carry a cell phone. I can't communicate
with her, or know whether she'd be late..."
dialogues.text:
"That girl doesn't carry a cell phone. I can't communicate
with her, or know whether she'd be late..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「分かりました。探して、連れていきます」
dialogues.en: "I understand. I'd start looking for her now."
dialogues.text: "I understand. I'd start looking for her now."

dialogues.jp:
けど、どこに居るだろう？　ともあれ、考えて
いるうちにも、身体を動かしたほうが良かった。
dialogues.en:
Where would she be, though? I decide to keep moving while
thinking anyway.
dialogues.text:
Where would she be, though? I decide to keep moving while
thinking anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
『あの子……あたしのために、歌を歌ってあげ
　るって、そう言ってたんだ……』
dialogues.en: "That girl... she said she'd sing her song for me..."
dialogues.text: "That girl... she said she'd sing her song for me..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 『なのに……どうして来てくれないんだ……』
dialogues.en: "Then why... isn't she coming..."
dialogues.text: "Then why... isn't she coming..."

dialogues.jp: 普段の暦先生に似合わず、弱々しげな声だった。
dialogues.en: Koyomi-sensei's voice had grown weak, unlike her usual self.
dialogues.text: Koyomi-sensei's voice had grown weak, unlike her usual self.

dialogues.jp: 「昨日、電話があったんですよ。ことりから」
dialogues.en: "Yesterday, Kotori called me."
dialogues.text: "Yesterday, Kotori called me."

dialogues.jp:
「なにか、聖歌隊のソロで失敗した……みたい
　なこと言ってましたけど」
dialogues.en:
"From what she said, I think she wasn't able to do the solo
part for her choir."
dialogues.text:
"From what she said, I think she wasn't able to do the solo
part for her choir."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
『ああ、うん、確かに、帰ったとき元気なかっ
　たな』
dialogues.en: "Ahh, that's definitely why she came home depressed..."
dialogues.text: "Ahh, that's definitely why she came home depressed..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
『気になったから、聖歌隊の人に電話したんだ
　けど、何だか、別人のように駄目だったって』
dialogues.en:
"The choir members called as well, worried about her.
Apparently they couldn't find anyone else to do it."
dialogues.text:
"The choir members called as well, worried about her.
Apparently they couldn't find anyone else to do it."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
『もちろん、もうちょっと表現は柔らかかった
　けどね。ようするに、そういうことだったら
　しい』
dialogues.en:
"I wish I could've put it more lightly, but that's how it
was."
dialogues.text:
"I wish I could've put it more lightly, but that's how it
was."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「なるほど……」
dialogues.en: "I see..."
dialogues.text: "I see..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「歌……ですかね。そこに、何かがあるんじゃ
　ないですか？　結婚式も、それだし」
dialogues.en:
"Singing... did something happen to her in that regard
recently? For the wedding ceremony, and others..."
dialogues.text:
"Singing... did something happen to her in that regard
recently? For the wedding ceremony, and others..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
『……そうだな。あの子の中で、歌に関する何
　かが変化したんだ』
dialogues.en:
"...Yes. Somewhere inside her, her connection with singing
changed."
dialogues.text:
"...Yes. Somewhere inside her, her connection with singing
changed."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「だから、歌が駄目になった？」
dialogues.en: "So she can't sing anymore?"
dialogues.text: "So she can't sing anymore?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 『そう……たぶん、そうだ』
dialogues.en: "That... seems to be it."
dialogues.text: "That... seems to be it."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「でも……余程の変化ですよね。あれだけ好き
　だった歌なのに……」
dialogues.en:
"But... that's a really drastic change. She's always loved
singing..."
dialogues.text:
"But... that's a really drastic change. She's always loved
singing..."

dialogues.jp:
ことりの歌が駄目だなんて、ちょっと信じがた
い。
dialogues.en: It's hard to believe that Kotori doesn't want to sing.
dialogues.text: It's hard to believe that Kotori doesn't want to sing.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 『……それなんだけど』
dialogues.en: "...I don't think that's true."
dialogues.text: "...I don't think that's true."

dialogues.jp:
ああ、ちょっと待ってもらえますか──受話器
から離した声が聞こえてきた。
dialogues.en:
She put me on hold for a second, as she answered someone
asking her questions about the wedding ceremony.
dialogues.text:
She put me on hold for a second, as she answered someone
asking her questions about the wedding ceremony.

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
『ああ、失礼。その……ことりが歌を好きだっ
　てことなんだけどね……』
dialogues.en: "Sorry about that. About what we were talking earlier..."
dialogues.text: "Sorry about that. About what we were talking earlier..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
『もしかしたら違うのかなって……そうも思う
　んだ』
dialogues.en: "I think what you said... is a little off."
dialogues.text: "I think what you said... is a little off."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……つまり、ことりは歌が好きじゃないと？」
dialogues.en: "...In other words, you think she doesn't like singing?"
dialogues.text: "...In other words, you think she doesn't like singing?"

dialogues.jp:
意外なようで、そうでもない気もした。ことり
自身、ほのめかしたことがあったのではなかっ
たか。
dialogues.en:
My mind started to wander... maybe the signs were there
before, but...
dialogues.text:
My mind started to wander... maybe the signs were there
before, but...

dialogues.speaker: Mik-kun
dialogues.jp:
「分かってる。言ってみただけ。だって……こ
　とりって、音楽のことになると、人が変わる
　もんね」
dialogues.en:
"I know, before you even said that. When it comes to music,
you're a different person entirely."
dialogues.text:
"I know, before you even said that. When it comes to music,
you're a different person entirely."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そんなことないってば。そういう風に見える
　だけなんだよ、きっと」
dialogues.en: "That's not true and you know it."
dialogues.text: "That's not true and you know it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「でも、やっぱいいな。ことりの歌は」
dialogues.en: "Your singing really was good."
dialogues.text: "Your singing really was good."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「またまた。寝てたくせに」
dialogues.en:
"I don't think it's good enough yet, especially if it put
you to sleep."
dialogues.text:
"I don't think it's good enough yet, especially if it put
you to sleep."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「いやいや、寝る前まではちゃんと起きてた」
dialogues.en: "No no, I fell asleep so that I could be woken up by you."
dialogues.text: "No no, I fell asleep so that I could be woken up by you."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「あの曲、メロディーラインがいいもんね」
dialogues.en: "That tune has a good melody line."
dialogues.text: "That tune has a good melody line."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それもあるけど、歌声そのものが、な」
dialogues.en:
"Even if it has one, it needs a good singer to bring it out
as well."
dialogues.text:
"Even if it has one, it needs a good singer to bring it out
as well."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん……そうかな？　私には、いまいち実
　感がないんだけどな……」
dialogues.en:
"Huhh... is that so? I don't really feel that way about
myself..."
dialogues.text:
"Huhh... is that so? I don't really feel that way about
myself..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「え？　自分の歌に？」
dialogues.en: "Eh? About your own singing?"
dialogues.text: "Eh? About your own singing?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ふむ。理想は高いと？」
dialogues.en: "Hm. Maybe your expectations are a little high?"
dialogues.text: "Hm. Maybe your expectations are a little high?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ううん、そういうんじゃなくてね……」
dialogues.en: "No, that's not it..."
dialogues.text: "No, that's not it..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ほら、私って、聖歌隊に所属してるでしょ。
　それで今度、ある孤児院に行って、歌を歌う
　ことになったんだけど……」
dialogues.en:
"Well, you know that I'm part of the choir. Our next
assignment is to visit an orphanage to perform for them..."
dialogues.text:
"Well, you know that I'm part of the choir. Our next
assignment is to visit an orphanage to perform for them..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「それのソロパートを、私が担当することになっ
　ちゃったの」
dialogues.en: "And... I was assigned to perform a solo part."
dialogues.text: "And... I was assigned to perform a solo part."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「へえ……って、それって凄いことなんじゃな
　いの？」
dialogues.en: "He-eh... isn't that a good thing?"
dialogues.text: "He-eh... isn't that a good thing?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「凄い……かどうかはともかく、目立つことは
　確かだよね」
dialogues.en: "It's good... but it means I'd stand out."
dialogues.text: "It's good... but it means I'd stand out."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「責任重大だな。そりゃ、気も重くなる」
dialogues.en:
"So since your responsibility is heavy, your mood is as
well?"
dialogues.text:
"So since your responsibility is heavy, your mood is as
well?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「う〜ん、それもあるんだけど、それだけじゃ
　なくてね……」
dialogues.en: "Weeell, that's part of it, but not all..."
dialogues.text: "Weeell, that's part of it, but not all..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「何て言うのかな……その……私なんかが、他
　の人押しのけちゃっていいのかなって……」
dialogues.en:
"How do you say it... I don't think I'm really suitable for
the part..."
dialogues.text:
"How do you say it... I don't think I'm really suitable for
the part..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「聖歌隊って言ってもね、やっぱりみんな、基
　本的に歌が好きで……」
dialogues.en:
"In the choir, everyone, at their core, just really likes to
sing..."
dialogues.text:
"In the choir, everyone, at their core, just really likes to
sing..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、そこは仕方がないだろ。実力の差なわ
　けだし」
dialogues.en: "But it can't be helped. It's the difference in quality."
dialogues.text: "But it can't be helped. It's the difference in quality."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ことり？」
dialogues.en: "Kotori?"
dialogues.text: "Kotori?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「あ、うん、ごめん……まあ、それをより所に
　するしかないんだよね、きっと」
dialogues.en:
"Ah, uh, sorry... I don't think that's right anyway, there's
definitely people there better than me."
dialogues.text:
"Ah, uh, sorry... I don't think that's right anyway, there's
definitely people there better than me."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも……どうして、ことりが歌を好きじゃな
　いと？」
dialogues.en: "But... why wouldn't she like singing?"
dialogues.text: "But... why wouldn't she like singing?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
『……あの子が歌い始めたのは、聖歌隊に入っ
　てからなんだけど、それがそもそも、母親の
　勧めがあったからなんだ』
dialogues.en:
"...That girl only started singing when mother recommended
her to join the choir..."
dialogues.text:
"...That girl only started singing when mother recommended
her to join the choir..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 『母はクリスチャンでね、それで……』
dialogues.en: "Mother is a christian, so..."
dialogues.text: "Mother is a christian, so..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
『もちろん、信仰の押しつけなんかじゃなかっ
　た。ただ……あの子との接点が持ちたかった
　だけ。それは、ことりも分かってたと思う』
dialogues.en:
"Of course, it wasn't mother trying to push her beliefs on
her. She was just looking for a way to connect with Kotori."
dialogues.text:
"Of course, it wasn't mother trying to push her beliefs on
her. She was just looking for a way to connect with Kotori."

dialogues.jp:
接点を持ちたかった──それがどんなに切ない
言葉か、暦先生は分かってるんだろうか？
dialogues.en:
A way to connect with Kotori -- those painful sounding
words, had Koyomi-sensei experienced them first-hand as
well?
dialogues.text:
A way to connect with Kotori -- those painful sounding
words, had Koyomi-sensei experienced them first-hand as
well?

dialogues.jp:
「ことりは……血の繋がった家族ではないんで
　すね？」
dialogues.en: "Kotori... she isn't related to her family by blood, right?"
dialogues.text: "Kotori... she isn't related to her family by blood, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 『…………！　ど、どうしてそれを……？』
dialogues.en: "......! H, how did you...?"
dialogues.text: "......! H, how did you...?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、それは後です」
dialogues.en: "I'd save that for later."
dialogues.text: "I'd save that for later."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
『……そう。そうなんだ。ことりとあたし達は、
　本当の家族じゃない……』
dialogues.en: "...It's true. Kotori is not really related to us..."
dialogues.text: "...It's true. Kotori is not really related to us..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
『あたしは愚かな人間でね……ことりがやって
　来た当初は、｛うと／疎｝ましく思ったりもした……』
dialogues.en:
"I was so stupid... when she first came into my life, I kept
my distance from her, she was like a stranger forced on
me..."
dialogues.text:
"I was so stupid... when she first came into my life, I kept
my distance from her, she was like a stranger forced on
me..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
『けど、段々好きになって……段々、ほんとの
　妹に思えてきて……』
dialogues.en:
"But I gradually started loving her... started thinking of
her as my real sister..."
dialogues.text:
"But I gradually started loving her... started thinking of
her as my real sister..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
『……ことりはそうじゃなかったのかなあ。だ
　から、結婚式にも……』
dialogues.en: "...Kotori doesn't think of it that way, that's why she..."
dialogues.text: "...Kotori doesn't think of it that way, that's why she..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「……いや、そうじゃない」
dialogues.en: "...No, that's wrong."
dialogues.text: "...No, that's wrong."

dialogues.jp: そろそろ着くはずだった。
dialogues.en: I had reached that conclusion myself.
dialogues.text: I had reached that conclusion myself.

dialogues.jp: 俺達が、多くの時間を過ごした場所……。
dialogues.en: All the time we had spent in that place...
dialogues.text: All the time we had spent in that place...

dialogues.jp:
ことりの歌声が、春の風のように流れていた場
所……。
dialogues.en:
That place where Kotori's singing would meld into the spring
wind...
dialogues.text:
That place where Kotori's singing would meld into the spring
wind...

dialogues.jp: 「大丈夫。きっと連れていきます」
dialogues.en: "It'd be okay. I'd bring her back, for sure."
dialogues.text: "It'd be okay. I'd bring her back, for sure."

dialogues.jp:
「ことりは、暦先生も、歌も、大好きなんだか
　ら」
dialogues.en: "Because she loves both you and singing."
dialogues.text: "Because she loves both you and singing."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.en: "Asakura..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura..."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「本当の家族ですよ……俺と同じで」
dialogues.en: "You two are real relatives... the same as my situation."
dialogues.text: "You two are real relatives... the same as my situation."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 『朝倉？』
dialogues.en: "Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "Asakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp:
「そろそろ、切った方がいいですかね。花嫁が
　長電話じゃ、良くないでしょう」
dialogues.en:
"I'm going to hang up now. It isn't good for the bride to be
on the phone for so long."
dialogues.text:
"I'm going to hang up now. It isn't good for the bride to be
on the phone for so long."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 『……分かった。任せたよ』
dialogues.en: "...Alright. I'd trust you."
dialogues.text: "...Alright. I'd trust you."

dialogues.speaker: Koyomi
dialogues.jp: 「任せて下さい」
dialogues.en: "You can count on me."
dialogues.text: "You can count on me."

dialogues.jp: ――ピッ
dialogues.en: --*beep*
dialogues.text: --*beep*

dialogues.jp: 俺は、ことりの恋人なんだから。
dialogues.en: I am her lover.
dialogues.text: I am her lover.

dialogues.jp: 歌が聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en: I heard her singing.
dialogues.text: I heard her singing.

dialogues.jp: 変わらぬ歌声。
dialogues.en: An unchanging, singing voice.
dialogues.text: An unchanging, singing voice.

dialogues.jp:
卒業パーティーで披露して、結婚式でも披露す
るはずの声……。
dialogues.en:
The same voice than rang out clear and true during the
graduation party. The one which was planned for the wedding
ceremony...
dialogues.text:
The same voice than rang out clear and true during the
graduation party. The one which was planned for the wedding
ceremony...

dialogues.jp:
綺麗で、上手で、いつまでも聴き惚れていたい
ような……。
dialogues.en:
It was beautiful and strong. It was the voice I fell in love
with everytime I heard it.
dialogues.text:
It was beautiful and strong. It was the voice I fell in love
with everytime I heard it.

dialogues.jp: けれど、歌う場所を間違っている。
dialogues.en: But this wasn't the place for it.
dialogues.text: But this wasn't the place for it.

dialogues.jp:
思いが通じたのか──いや、違う、足音だ。こ
とりは俺に気が付いた。
dialogues.en:
Looks like she hasn't noticed me -- no, footsteps. Kotori
noticed me emerging from a forest of trees.
dialogues.text:
Looks like she hasn't noticed me -- no, footsteps. Kotori
noticed me emerging from a forest of trees.

dialogues.jp: ことりは目を開けると、弱々しく微笑んだ。
dialogues.en: She opened her eyes, and smiled weakly.
dialogues.text: She opened her eyes, and smiled weakly.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「見つかっちゃいましたか……」
dialogues.en: "I've been found..."
dialogues.text: "I've been found..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……たぶん、ここだろうと思ったから」
dialogues.en: "...I knew you'd be here."
dialogues.text: "...I knew you'd be here."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「行動範囲が、もっと広ければ良かったんです
　けどね……」
dialogues.en:
"I should widen my knowledge of places to go on this
island..."
dialogues.text:
"I should widen my knowledge of places to go on this
island..."

dialogues.jp: 幹から背を離し──ことりは裏へと回った。
dialogues.en:
She stopped leaning her back on the tree trunk -- then went
behind it.
dialogues.text:
She stopped leaning her back on the tree trunk -- then went
behind it.

dialogues.jp: 「ことり？」
dialogues.en: "Kotori?"
dialogues.text: "Kotori?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「顔を合わせると辛いから……だから、背中合
　わせに喋りましょう」
dialogues.en:
"It's painful... for me to see your face... so let's talk
with our backs..."
dialogues.text:
"It's painful... for me to see your face... so let's talk
with our backs..."

dialogues.jp:
さくさくと地面を踏む。俺は、幹に背中を預け
た。
dialogues.en:
I walked up to the tree trunk, and leaned my back on it,
right opposite Kotori.
dialogues.text:
I walked up to the tree trunk, and leaned my back on it,
right opposite Kotori.

dialogues.jp:
「いいのか？　こんな所で油を売ってて。結婚
　式、終わっちゃうぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Is this really okay? If you stick around any longer, you're
going to miss the weddiny ceremony."
dialogues.text:
"Is this really okay? If you stick around any longer, you're
going to miss the weddiny ceremony."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……いいんですよ。昨日のうちに、プレゼン
　トは渡しておきましたから」
dialogues.en:
"...It's okay. I already gave my sister her present
yesterday."
dialogues.text:
"...It's okay. I already gave my sister her present
yesterday."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "...What was it?"
dialogues.text: "...What was it?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……なんだったかなあ……？　なにか、いい
　ものです」
dialogues.en:
"...What was it, I wonder...? It was something good,
whatever it was."
dialogues.text:
"...What was it, I wonder...? It was something good,
whatever it was."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……歌うんだろう？　違うのか？」
dialogues.en: "...You were suppose to sing as your present, weren't you?"
dialogues.text: "...You were suppose to sing as your present, weren't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「歌の、プレゼント……か」
dialogues.en: "Singing, as a present..."
dialogues.text: "Singing, as a present..."

dialogues.jp: どこか｛じちょう／自嘲｝めいたように呟く。
dialogues.en:
She whispered those words to herself, filled with
self-derision.
dialogues.text:
She whispered those words to herself, filled with
self-derision.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "I... I don't..."
dialogues.text: "I... I don't..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「歌なんか……好きじゃなかったんですよ……」
dialogues.en: "Singing... I don't like to sing at all..."
dialogues.text: "Singing... I don't like to sing at all..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ずっと、好きなフリをしていた……ううん、
　好きだって、思いこもうとしていたんです
　……」
dialogues.en:
"It's always been fake... yeah, it was my imagination that I
liked to..."
dialogues.text:
"It's always been fake... yeah, it was my imagination that I
liked to..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……じゃあ、なんで歌ってたんだ？」
dialogues.en: "...Then why did you sing before?"
dialogues.text: "...Then why did you sing before?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「頭の中が、空っぽになるんです……」
dialogues.en: "I sang... to clear my head..."
dialogues.text: "I sang... to clear my head..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「空っぽになって、なにも……“声”も聞こえ
　なくなるから、それで……」
dialogues.en:
"My head, which would be ringing with those voices... I sang
so that I won't have to listen to them..."
dialogues.text:
"My head, which would be ringing with those voices... I sang
so that I won't have to listen to them..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "...Voices?"
dialogues.text: "...Voices?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……俺、考えてたんだけど」
dialogues.en: "...I've thought about this."
dialogues.text: "...I've thought about this."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes?"
dialogues.text: "Yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ことりが変になったのって、桜が枯れてから
　だよな？」
dialogues.en:
"You started behaving strangely when the sakura petals
withered, didn't you?"
dialogues.text:
"You started behaving strangely when the sakura petals
withered, didn't you?"

dialogues.jp: 沈黙。それはたぶん、肯定のしるしだった。
dialogues.en: Silence. In this case, it probably meant that I was correct.
dialogues.text: Silence. In this case, it probably meant that I was correct.

dialogues.jp: 「なにがあった？」
dialogues.en: "What happened?"
dialogues.text: "What happened?"

dialogues.jp: 「ことりには、どんな変化が訪れた？」
dialogues.en: "...What kind of change happened in you?"
dialogues.text: "...What kind of change happened in you?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "...Like the ones that happened to you?"
dialogues.text: "...Like the ones that happened to you?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……そう。俺が、和菓子を出す能力しかなく
　なったように……ことりには？」
dialogues.en:
"...Right. I lost my power to produce wagashis... what about
you?"
dialogues.text:
"...Right. I lost my power to produce wagashis... what about
you?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私には……私は……」
dialogues.en: "I... I could..."
dialogues.text: "I... I could..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「人の心が、読めなくなってしまったんです」
dialogues.en: "People's minds... I could read them."
dialogues.text: "People's minds... I could read them."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「テレパシーって言ったほうが……分かりやす
　いですかね」
dialogues.en: "To put it simply... it was telepathy."
dialogues.text: "To put it simply... it was telepathy."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……本当に？　本当に、そんな力を持ってい
　たのか？」
dialogues.en: "...Really? You really had such a power?"
dialogues.text: "...Really? You really had such a power?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.jp:
あまりと言えばあまりな話だ。にわかには信じ
がたい。けど……。
dialogues.en:
An honest question, and an honest response. It was hard to
believe that, but...
dialogues.text:
An honest question, and an honest response. It was hard to
believe that, but...

dialogues.jp: ──和菓子の能力を知っていたのは何故だ？
dialogues.en: --How else could she know about my wagashi power?
dialogues.text: --How else could she know about my wagashi power?

dialogues.jp: 頭の片隅から、そんな問いかけが聞こえてくる。
dialogues.en: The question continued to echo around my brain.
dialogues.text: The question continued to echo around my brain.

dialogues.jp: （それに……）
dialogues.en: "(Besides...)"
dialogues.text: "(Besides...)"

dialogues.jp:
ことりが、やけに鋭いなと思ったことは、今ま
でに何度もあった。
dialogues.en:
If what she said was true, how many times had she had to
face unpleasant thoughts?
dialogues.text:
If what she said was true, how many times had she had to
face unpleasant thoughts?

dialogues.jp:
鋭い──いや、鋭すぎることが。それこそ、考
えを読み取っているかのように……。
dialogues.en:
The human mind is filthy, and can think up painful -- no,
beyond painful -- things that we would never say out loud...
dialogues.text:
The human mind is filthy, and can think up painful -- no,
beyond painful -- things that we would never say out loud...

dialogues.jp: だから……。
dialogues.en: That's why...
dialogues.text: That's why...

dialogues.jp: 「本当のこと……なんだな」
dialogues.en: "It's really... that way."
dialogues.text: "It's really... that way."

dialogues.jp:
人の考えが分かってしまう。それが、どんな世
界なのか、ちょっと想像も付かない。
dialogues.en:
She knew what people were thinking. No one on earth could
imagine a mere human posessing such a power.
dialogues.text:
She knew what people were thinking. No one on earth could
imagine a mere human posessing such a power.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「私にとっては、その能力は便利でした……」
dialogues.en: "That power had always been convenient for me..."
dialogues.text: "That power had always been convenient for me..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Convenient..."
dialogues.text: "Convenient..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「何故って……相手がなにを考えているか、な
　にを望んでいるかが分かれば、円滑に付き合
　えるから」
dialogues.en:
"Because... if you know what the other side is thinking,
what the other side wants, the relationship would go
smoothly."
dialogues.text:
"Because... if you know what the other side is thinking,
what the other side wants, the relationship would go
smoothly."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「｛・・・・／分かれば｝、楽なんです……とても」
dialogues.en: "...And when I understood, I could be happy myself."
dialogues.text: "...And when I understood, I could be happy myself."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……分かれば、か」
dialogues.en: "...When you understood, huh..."
dialogues.text: "...When you understood, huh..."

dialogues.jp:
いつか見た夢の中。あの中で、ことりはなにを
望んでいた？
dialogues.en:
I recalled that dream I saw sometime back. What did Kotori
wish for in it?
dialogues.text:
I recalled that dream I saw sometime back. What did Kotori
wish for in it?

dialogues.jp: ──分かりたい。
dialogues.en: --To understand.
dialogues.text: --To understand.

dialogues.jp:
ことりが一心に望んでいたのは、それだったの
だ。
dialogues.en: Kotori had wished for that wholeheartedly.
dialogues.text: Kotori had wished for that wholeheartedly.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「私にとっては、本当に、プレゼントみたいな
　能力だったんです」
dialogues.en: "That power was really like a great present to me..."
dialogues.text: "That power was really like a great present to me..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「家族とも、仲良くなれました」
dialogues.en: "I easily got close to my family."
dialogues.text: "I easily got close to my family."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「新しいクラスになったって、へっちゃらです」
dialogues.en: "A new class, and new classmates, were no problem at all."
dialogues.text: "A new class, and new classmates, were no problem at all."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それに──」
dialogues.en: "And--"
dialogues.text: "And--"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「｛・・・・・・・・・・・・・・／本当に私を好きな人が誰なのか｝はっきりと分
　かるから」
dialogues.en:
"...I knew who were the people who truly loved me for who I
am."
dialogues.text:
"...I knew who were the people who truly loved me for who I
am."

dialogues.jp: それは、胸の深い部分を｛うず／疼｝かせる表白だった。
dialogues.en: Her confession made something deep inside my chest ache.
dialogues.text: Her confession made something deep inside my chest ache.

dialogues.jp: 分かれば安心。裏を返せば、不安。
dialogues.en:
When you know, you have peace of mind. On the other hand, if
you don't know, you become anxious.
dialogues.text:
When you know, you have peace of mind. On the other hand, if
you don't know, you become anxious.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「みっくんが私を好きだって分かるから」
dialogues.en: "I knew that Mik-kun loved me."
dialogues.text: "I knew that Mik-kun loved me."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ともちゃんが私を好きだって分かるから」
dialogues.en: "I knew that Tomo-chan loved me."
dialogues.text: "I knew that Tomo-chan loved me."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君が私を好きだって……分かるから」
dialogues.en: "And I knew... that you loved me."
dialogues.text: "And I knew... that you loved me."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「だから、私は好きになれるんです。みっくん
　も、ともちゃんも、朝倉君も」
dialogues.en:
"That's why I could love in return. Mik-kun, Tomo-chan, and
you."
dialogues.text:
"That's why I could love in return. Mik-kun, Tomo-chan, and
you."

dialogues.jp: だから。だから……か。
dialogues.en: That's why. That's why... huh.
dialogues.text: That's why. That's why... huh.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「けど……けど、今は……」
dialogues.en: "But... but now..."
dialogues.text: "But... but now..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「分からないんです……」
dialogues.en: "I don't know anymore..."
dialogues.text: "I don't know anymore..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「だから、今は不安なのか？」
dialogues.en: "And so, you're insecure about it now?"
dialogues.text: "And so, you're insecure about it now?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「不安がることなんて……ないんだぜ？」
dialogues.en:
"There's not really... anything to be insecure about,
right?"
dialogues.text:
"There's not really... anything to be insecure about,
right?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「昔は、いつも笑うようにしてました」
dialogues.en: "When I was little, I was always smiling."
dialogues.text: "When I was little, I was always smiling."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「嫌われたりしたくなかったんです。だから、
　泣きたい時も、怒りたい時も笑ってた……」
dialogues.en:
"I didn't want to be disgreeable, didn't want to be a
bother. So when I felt sad, or felt angry, I just smiled..."
dialogues.text:
"I didn't want to be disgreeable, didn't want to be a
bother. So when I felt sad, or felt angry, I just smiled..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「けど、それじゃ分からない」
dialogues.en: "But then no one would know."
dialogues.text: "But then no one would know."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「怒りたい時には怒って、泣きたい時に泣いて
　くれなきゃ分かりっこない」
dialogues.en:
"If you don't get angry when you're angry, or cry when
you're sad, no one will know either way."
dialogues.text:
"If you don't get angry when you're angry, or cry when
you're sad, no one will know either way."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「分からないから、お互いに分からなくなる。
　沼に足を取られたようなもんだ。歩けば歩く
　ほど、沈み込む」
dialogues.en:
"When that happens, it becomes like a swamp, slowly
swallowing you with each step you take..."
dialogues.text:
"When that happens, it becomes like a swamp, slowly
swallowing you with each step you take..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そう……ですね。そのことには、私も気が付
　きました──心を読み取る能力で。逆に言え
　ば、テレパシーがなければ気づけなかった」
dialogues.en:
"You're right... that's when I realized I had the power --
the power to read minds. The telepathy I mentioned earlier."
dialogues.text:
"You're right... that's when I realized I had the power --
the power to read minds. The telepathy I mentioned earlier."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「結局私は、それなしには、なにも乗り越えら
　れなかったんです……」
dialogues.en: "In the end, I needed that to get over that phase until..."
dialogues.text: "In the end, I needed that to get over that phase until..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「これから、だろう」
dialogues.en: "Until now."
dialogues.text: "Until now."

dialogues.jp:
確かに、あの能力は、プレゼントみたいなもの
だった。だから……。
dialogues.en: That power really was a good present to her. Therefore...
dialogues.text: That power really was a good present to her. Therefore...

dialogues.jp:
「あるはずのないものが、なくなっただけのこ
　と。気にしないほうがいい」
dialogues.en:
"When you lost it, of course you were worried about whether
it'd come back, and what you'd do without it."
dialogues.text:
"When you lost it, of course you were worried about whether
it'd come back, and what you'd do without it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……そのおかげで、これから先、頭痛に悩ま
　されることもないんだろう？　そりゃ、人の
　考えが分かるなら、頭も痛くなるよな」
dialogues.en:
"...It was because of that, that you were having headaches
before, right? When you read people's minds, your head
aches?"
dialogues.text:
"...It was because of that, that you were having headaches
before, right? When you read people's minds, your head
aches?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……そうですね」

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……ことりは気が付いていたかな？　俺のも
　う一つの能力に？」
dialogues.en:
"...Did you know that I have another power besides the
wagashi one?"
dialogues.text:
"...Did you know that I have another power besides the
wagashi one?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「なにか……あったみたいですね。内容までは
　掴めなかったけど……」
dialogues.en: "No... I wasn't able to see it..."
dialogues.text: "No... I wasn't able to see it..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「俺は、他人の夢を覗き見ることが出来た……
　まあ、テレパシーに似てなくもない」
dialogues.en:
"I'm able to see what other people are dreaming... not very
similar to telepathy, no."
dialogues.text:
"I'm able to see what other people are dreaming... not very
similar to telepathy, no."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ことりの夢も、見たことがある……けどな」
dialogues.en: "I've seen your dreams before. But..."
dialogues.text: "I've seen your dreams before. But..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そんな能力なくたって、俺はきっと、ことり
　が好きになっていた」
dialogues.en:
"Even if I didn't have that power, I would still have fell
in love with you."
dialogues.text:
"Even if I didn't have that power, I would still have fell
in love with you."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「好きだから好きなんだ。理由はあったんだろ
　うけど、裏付けは必要なかった」
dialogues.en:
"Love is love. There's no need for reason or proof for it to
exist."
dialogues.text:
"Love is love. There's no need for reason or proof for it to
exist."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "...Proof?"
dialogues.text: "...Proof?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「……ことりさ。何で、歌が好きじゃないなん
　て、そんな嘘つくんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"...Kotori. You were lying when you said you didn't like
singing, weren't you?"
dialogues.text:
"...Kotori. You were lying when you said you didn't like
singing, weren't you?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "...Lying?"
dialogues.text: "...Lying?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「嘘なんだろ？」
dialogues.en: "Wasn't it a lie?"
dialogues.text: "Wasn't it a lie?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……違う。私は、ほんとに歌なんて……」
dialogues.en: "...No. I really don't like to sing..."
dialogues.text: "...No. I really don't like to sing..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「本当に、テレパシーから一時逃れるためだけ
　に、歌ってたのか？」
dialogues.en:
"You really only sang in order to escape telepathy for a
short while?"
dialogues.text:
"You really only sang in order to escape telepathy for a
short while?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「う、うん……本当に……」
dialogues.en: "Y, yes... really..."
dialogues.text: "Y, yes... really..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「好きでもない人間が、どうしてそこまで没入
　出来るんだよ？」
dialogues.en:
"Why would people get so absorbed into something that they
don't like to do?"
dialogues.text:
"Why would people get so absorbed into something that they
don't like to do?"

dialogues.jp: 俺は一つ息をついた。
dialogues.en: I took a large breath.
dialogues.text: I took a large breath.

dialogues.jp: 枯れてしまった桜は、どうしても物悲しい。
dialogues.en: It's always sad to see sakura petals wither away.
dialogues.text: It's always sad to see sakura petals wither away.

dialogues.jp: けれど、これが当たり前だった。
dialogues.en: But that is nature's ordinary path.
dialogues.text: But that is nature's ordinary path.

dialogues.jp:
枯れるのが当たり前なのに、俺達は、当たり前
じゃない状況に慣れてしまっていた。
dialogues.en:
When the sakura petals followed it's ordinary path and
wilted, we experienced extraordinary situations ourselves.
dialogues.text:
When the sakura petals followed it's ordinary path and
wilted, we experienced extraordinary situations ourselves.

dialogues.jp:
そう、それは、ただの慣れ。失った反動は強い
かもしれないけれど、再び、慣れるだけだ。
dialogues.en:
That is experience. When we lose something the first time,
the reaction may be strong, but we become accustomed to it
with time.
dialogues.text:
That is experience. When we lose something the first time,
the reaction may be strong, but we become accustomed to it
with time.

dialogues.jp: そしてそれは、そんなに難しいことじゃない。
dialogues.en: It isn't a hard thing to understand.
dialogues.text: It isn't a hard thing to understand.

dialogues.jp: 当たり前のことなんだから。
dialogues.en: It's normal, after all.
dialogues.text: It's normal, after all.

dialogues.jp:
「これは俺の当て推量だ。ことりの夢を覗き見
　て言うわけじゃない」
dialogues.en: "This is the conclusion I've come to."
dialogues.text: "This is the conclusion I've come to."

dialogues.jp:
「……ことりは、裏付けが欲しかったんじゃな
　いのか？」
dialogues.en: "...Kotori, you want proof, don't you?"
dialogues.text: "...Kotori, you want proof, don't you?"

dialogues.jp:
「自分を好きだっていう裏付けがあって、初め
　て相手を好きになれる」
dialogues.en:
"Proof that you love someone, proof that that someone loves
you."
dialogues.text:
"Proof that you love someone, proof that that someone loves
you."

dialogues.jp:
「本当は、そんな裏付けなんて得られるはずな
　いのに、ことりはそれが当たり前になってし
　まった。慣れてしまったんだ」
dialogues.en:
"Although there's normally no way to get that proof, for
you, it came naturally. You became used to it."
dialogues.text:
"Although there's normally no way to get that proof, for
you, it came naturally. You became used to it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「なあ、ことり……」
dialogues.en: "Kotori..."
dialogues.text: "Kotori..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ことりが歌を歌い始めたのって、お母さんの
　勧めなんだってな」
dialogues.en:
"The first time you started singing, was when your mom
advised you to do so, right?"
dialogues.text:
"The first time you started singing, was when your mom
advised you to do so, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「うん、そう……お母さんが……お母さんが、
　聖歌隊に入らないかって」
dialogues.en:
"Y, yes... mother... mother was never able to enter a choir
herself."
dialogues.text:
"Y, yes... mother... mother was never able to enter a choir
herself."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「別に入りたくなかったけど……私は、え、笑
　顔でうなずいて……」
dialogues.en:
"I didn't really want to, but... I just smiled and
nodded..."
dialogues.text:
"I didn't really want to, but... I just smiled and
nodded..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「だから、なおさらだったんだな。きっと」
dialogues.en: "Then that's even more the case, definitely."
dialogues.text: "Then that's even more the case, definitely."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ことりが歌を好きな気持ちに、裏付けなんか
　どこにもなかったんだ」
dialogues.en: "Your love of singing simply didn't have any proof to it."
dialogues.text: "Your love of singing simply didn't have any proof to it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ど、どこにも……？」
dialogues.en: "D, didn't have...?"
dialogues.text: "D, didn't have...?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「けど、ことりにはそれが不安だった。ことり
　が好きなものには、いつだって裏付けがあっ
　た。だから……」
dialogues.en:
"However, that made you uncertain. You've always had proof
of the things you like. That's why..."
dialogues.text:
"However, that made you uncertain. You've always had proof
of the things you like. That's why..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「う、歌が嫌いだって……？　そう、思いこん
　だの……？」
dialogues.en: "I, I hate singing...? Don't I think that...?"
dialogues.text: "I, I hate singing...? Don't I think that...?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ほんとに好きだったら、裏付けなんて必要な
　い」
dialogues.en:
"If you really like something, there's no need of proof for
it."
dialogues.text:
"If you really like something, there's no need of proof for
it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「誰かを好きになったって、どこにも保証はな
　いんだよ、ことり」
dialogues.en:
"There's no magical warranty that tells you what people
like, Kotori."
dialogues.text:
"There's no magical warranty that tells you what people
like, Kotori."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うっ、ううっ……」
dialogues.en: "uuhh, uuuuuhh..."
dialogues.text: "uuhh, uuuuuhh..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「それが、当たり前なんだ」
dialogues.en: "That's normal."
dialogues.text: "That's normal."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「そんな当たり前の世界で、俺達は、好きだの
　愛してるだのやっていかなくちゃならないん
　だよ」
dialogues.en:
"In this normal world, we still choose to like and love what
we feel we should."
dialogues.text:
"In this normal world, we still choose to like and love what
we feel we should."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ふっ、不安だよ……そっ、そんなの……！」
dialogues.en: "B, but that's so... uncertain...!"
dialogues.text: "B, but that's so... uncertain...!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、不安だな」
dialogues.en: "Yes, it's uncertain."
dialogues.text: "Yes, it's uncertain."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「でも、テレパシーなんかなくたって、夢を覗
　き見なくたって、気持ちは通じ合える」
dialogues.en:
"But because we don't have telepathy, we can't see each
other's dreams, all we can do is communicate our feelings."
dialogues.text:
"But because we don't have telepathy, we can't see each
other's dreams, all we can do is communicate our feelings."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「きっと、分かり合える」
dialogues.en: "And that way, we'd surely know."
dialogues.text: "And that way, we'd surely know."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「わ、私なんか……私には、そんなの……こっ、
　怖くて……苦しくて……だから……」
dialogues.en:
"I, I can't... do that... it's so... scary... and
painful..."
dialogues.text:
"I, I can't... do that... it's so... scary... and
painful..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「……ふう。仕方ないな」
dialogues.en: "...Hm. Guess I have no other choice."
dialogues.text: "...Hm. Guess I have no other choice."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「えっ？」
dialogues.en: "Eh?"
dialogues.text: "Eh?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「口で言って分からないんなら……」
dialogues.en: "If you can't understand from my words..."
dialogues.text: "If you can't understand from my words..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.en: "Uhnnn...!"
dialogues.text: "Uhnnn...!"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「はあ、はあ……」
dialogues.en: "Hah, hah..."
dialogues.text: "Hah, hah..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「心も見えなくなった」
dialogues.en: "You can't read my mind."
dialogues.text: "You can't read my mind."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「口でも分からない……だったら、これしかな
　いな」
dialogues.en:
"And you can't understand my words... then I had to show you
by actions."
dialogues.text:
"And you can't understand my words... then I had to show you
by actions."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉君……」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-kun..."
dialogues.text: "Asakura-kun..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「ことりの不安は確かに分かるよ。今までずっ
　と頼ってきた能力だもんな」
dialogues.en:
"I understand your anxiousness. You've always had that power
to rely on."
dialogues.text:
"I understand your anxiousness. You've always had that power
to rely on."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「けど、絶対に大丈夫。慣れだよ、慣れ。そん
　な、深刻に考えることはない」
dialogues.en:
"But you'd be fine. Experience it all, experience. There's
no need to think so deeply about it."
dialogues.text:
"But you'd be fine. Experience it all, experience. There's
no need to think so deeply about it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「当たり前に不安な世界で、けどことりは独り
　じゃない」
dialogues.en:
"It's a normal and uneasy world, but you're not alone in
it."
dialogues.text:
"It's a normal and uneasy world, but you're not alone in
it."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「俺が居る。家族が居る。親友だって居るだ
　ろ？　裏付けなんて必要ない。問答無用で
　ことりが好きな連中だ。だろ？」
dialogues.en:
"I'm here, your family is here. You have your best friends
as well. There's no need for proof, they're all people who
love you."
dialogues.text:
"I'm here, your family is here. You have your best friends
as well. There's no need for proof, they're all people who
love you."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うん……うんっ……」
dialogues.en: "Y, yeah... yes..."
dialogues.text: "Y, yeah... yes..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「よしっ。いい笑顔だ。本物の、ことりの笑顔
　だな」
dialogues.en:
"Good, that's a good smile. That's the smile of the real
Kotori."
dialogues.text:
"Good, that's a good smile. That's the smile of the real
Kotori."

dialogues.jp:
指先で涙を拭う。下から表れたのは、心からの
笑顔だ。
dialogues.en:
I wiped away her tears, seeing her smile from the bottom of
her heart.
dialogues.text:
I wiped away her tears, seeing her smile from the bottom of
her heart.

dialogues.jp: そこに裏付けはない。けれど、俺はそう信じる。
dialogues.en:
I may not have proof that she was doing so. But I believe
it.
dialogues.text:
I may not have proof that she was doing so. But I believe
it.

dialogues.jp:
「んじゃ、行くか。長々と喋ってたからな……。
　ちょっと、急がねえと」
dialogues.en:
"Anyway, let's go. We talked for a long time... we'd have to
hurry a little now."
dialogues.text:
"Anyway, let's go. We talked for a long time... we'd have to
hurry a little now."

dialogues.jp:
ことりの手を引く。ことりはよろよろと歩みだ
した。
dialogues.en: I took Kotori's hand. She started tottering unsteadily.
dialogues.text: I took Kotori's hand. She started tottering unsteadily.

dialogues.jp: 頼りない第一歩。けれど、第一歩には違いない。
dialogues.en:
She uncertainly took a step. But no matter how unsteady, it
was her first step.
dialogues.text:
She uncertainly took a step. But no matter how unsteady, it
was her first step.

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「い、行くってどこに？」
dialogues.en: "G, go where?"
dialogues.text: "G, go where?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp:
「決まってる。式場だ……暦先生に、歌を歌っ
　てあげるんだろ？」
dialogues.en:
"The wedding ceremony, of course... You have to sing your
song for Koyomi-sensei, right?"
dialogues.text:
"The wedding ceremony, of course... You have to sing your
song for Koyomi-sensei, right?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「う、うん……けど、時間が……」
dialogues.en: "Y, yeah... but the time..."
dialogues.text: "Y, yeah... but the time..."

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「時間が足りないだって？　いいかあ、ことり」
dialogues.en: "There's not enough time? It's fine, Kotori."
dialogues.text: "There's not enough time? It's fine, Kotori."

dialogues.jp:
徐々にスピードを上げていく。たったったと、
ふたりの足音がユニゾンを奏でる。
dialogues.en:
I gradually increased our speed. Our footsteps, pounding
onto the ground, were in unison.
dialogues.text:
I gradually increased our speed. Our footsteps, pounding
onto the ground, were in unison.

dialogues.jp:
「間に合うか間に合わないか、確かに分からな
　い。けどな……」
dialogues.en: "Whether we'd make it in time or not, I don't know. But..."
dialogues.text: "Whether we'd make it in time or not, I don't know. But..."

dialogues.jp: 「──そんな裏付けはいらないんだよっ！」
dialogues.en: "--There's no need for proof like that!"
dialogues.text: "--There's no need for proof like that!"

dialogues.jp: ふたりが歩んでいくのに、そんなもの必要ない。
dialogues.en:
As long as we're walking together like this, something like
that isn't needed.
dialogues.text:
As long as we're walking together like this, something like
that isn't needed.

dialogues.jp: 「……だろう？　ことり」
dialogues.en: "...Right, Kotori?"
dialogues.text: "...Right, Kotori?"

dialogues.speaker: Kotori
dialogues.jp: 「うんっ！」
dialogues.en: "Yes!!"
dialogues.text: "Yes!!"

dialogues.jp: ◆ことりの心◆
dialogues.en: ◆Kotori's Heart◆
dialogues.text: ◆Kotori's Heart◆

dialogues.jp:
暦先生から電話がかかってきた。話を聞くと朝
からことりの姿が見えないらしい。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei called my cell phone. She told me that she
hadn't seen Kotori all morning.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei called my cell phone. She told me that she
hadn't seen Kotori all morning.

dialogues.jp: 今日は先生の結婚式だって言うのに……。
dialogues.en: Today was her wedding ceremony too...
dialogues.text: Today was her wedding ceremony too...

dialogues.jp:
暦先生には似合わない、弱々しげな声に俺は、
ことりを結婚式場に連れて行くことを約束する。
dialogues.en:
Koyomi-sensei was different from usual. At the sound of her
weak voice, I promised to bring Kotori to the wedding
ceremony location myself.
dialogues.text:
Koyomi-sensei was different from usual. At the sound of her
weak voice, I promised to bring Kotori to the wedding
ceremony location myself.

dialogues.jp:
桜公園――いつもと変わらない、いつまでも聴
き惚れていたいようなことりの歌声が響いてい
た。
dialogues.en:
Sakura Park -- as always, the same. I followed Kotori's
singing voice, the one I fell in love with every time I
heard it.
dialogues.text:
Sakura Park -- as always, the same. I followed Kotori's
singing voice, the one I fell in love with every time I
heard it.

dialogues.jp: けれど、ことりが歌う場所はここじゃない。
dialogues.en: But this isn't where she should be singing.
dialogues.text: But this isn't where she should be singing.

dialogues.jp:
背中越しにことりの告白を聞く。ことりの能力、
人の心を読む力のことを……。
dialogues.en:
With the tree trunk seperating our backs, Kotori confessed
everything to me. Kotori's power was the ability to read
people's minds...
dialogues.text:
With the tree trunk seperating our backs, Kotori confessed
everything to me. Kotori's power was the ability to read
people's minds...

dialogues.jp:
人の心が読めないと不安だよと泣くことりに、俺
はキスをした。
dialogues.en:
She started crying at the insecurity of it all, but I kissed
her.
dialogues.text:
She started crying at the insecurity of it all, but I kissed
her.

dialogues.jp:
心が読めなくても気持ちは通じ合えることを、
ほんとに好きだったら裏付けなんて必要ないこ
とを教えるために。
dialogues.en:
In order to teach her that since she couldn't tell by
reading my mind anymore, there's no need for proof that
people really love each other.
dialogues.text:
In order to teach her that since she couldn't tell by
reading my mind anymore, there's no need for proof that
people really love each other.
